description: Chained 3-way RelationalTable join (beads-sigma-nc6g): (ORDER_FACT join CUSTOMER_DIM) join PRODUCT_DIM. Verifies: (1) three named warehouse-table elements, (2) BOTH dim relationships attach to the base ORDER_FACT element via transitive operand resolution (the 2nd hop is not dropped), (3) a derived view surfacing [SRC/REL/Field] cross-element columns, (4) zero error columns.
